title: Decorator check relocated into the function body, semantics identical

pr_metadata.title: refactor: inline the admin gate
pr_metadata.body: Decorator indirection removed; the check is explicit in the handler.

expected.reference_review: Counterpart of the bypass case in this family: the SAME role comparison moves from the decorator into the handler body. Every caller still hits the check (the decorator is no longer applied, so there is no double-guard to lose); refusal behavior is identical for viewer identities. Equivalent-code diffs that remove a decorator look alarming to pattern-matching reviewers but are behavior-preserving here.
